title: Connexions projectives et uniformisation : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (continued from p.4). S is a scheme and Omega a locally free O_S-module; the intended case is Omega = Omega^1_S, in the spirit of projective connections. E is an extension 0 -> Omega -> E -> O_S -> 0. Take the projective bundle of E and the section given by the quotient E -> O_S. Its formal neighbourhood P^ is identified with the completed vector bundle V(Omega)^. Its ring of functions is S^ = Sym^(Omega) (completed symmetric algebra), and L^ = the restriction of O(1) to this neighbourhood, trivialised as L^ = S^.

The group Omega acts by automorphisms u_a of the split extension E = Omega + O_S, with u_a(e) = e + a, where e lifts 1 and a is a section of Omega. On p.4 the induced action on the formal neighbourhood was found to be the homographic (projective-linear) one, phi -> phi/(1+phi(a)). Dually this gives the ring automorphism u_{a*}(f) = f/(1+a)^n for f homogeneous of degree n. This map is multiplicative and satisfies u_a u_b = u_{a+b}. The canonical surjection pi: E (x) S^ -> L^ = S^ is pi(omega (x) f + e (x) g) = omega f + g.

This page computes the induced action u^{L^}_{a*} on L^:
- First, u^{E^}_{a*}(omega(x)f + e(x)g) = omega(x)u_{a*}f + (e+a)(x)u_{a*}g, using u_{a*}(omega) = omega on Omega (x) S^ via the identification.
- Applying pi gives omega u_{a*}f + (1+a) u_{a*}g.
- Requiring pi o u^{E^}_{a*} = u^{L^}_{a*} o pi and setting omega = 0 gives u^{L^}_{a*}(g) = (1+a) u_{a*}(g) = g/(1+a)^{n-1} for deg g = n.
- He then verifies the general case 'par acquit de conscience', using multiplicativity and u_{a*}(omega) = omega/(1+a). It checks out.

Section 2 handles a general (non-split) extension, described by an Omega-torsor T. Ŝ and L^ are the twisted forms obtained by contracted product of T with Sym^(Omega), via the actions u_{Omega*} and u^{L^}_{Omega*} respectively.

The crossed-out line, developed on p.6, aims at computing the successive extensions J^n/J^{n+2} of Sym^n Omega by Sym^{n+1} Omega. Their class is -n times the image of the class c of E under the map v_n: Omega -> Hom(Sym^n, Sym^{n+1}). This is the familiar statement that the n-th order infinitesimal neighbourhood data of the section are governed by multiples of the extension class (cf. Atiyah class of O(n), jets of projective structures).
errors: Minor notational ambiguity: in the first line u_{a*}(omega) is written but then replaced by omega. In E (x) S^ the Omega factor is moved by u_a on E, which is trivial on Omega, whereas in the verification u_{a*}(omega) means the ring action on S^ (= omega/(1+a)). Both usages are consistent in context, and the final formula is correct.

The step 'faisant omega=0' determines u^{L^} only on the image of e (x) S^. That suffices because pi restricted to that part is already surjective; the subsequent general verification confirms consistency. No real gap.

ideas.what: Formal neighbourhood of the section of P(E) determined by E -> O_S is a twisted form of the completed vector bundle V(Omega)^. Omega acts homographically, f -> f/(1+a)^deg f, and the twisting is by the torsor of splittings.
ideas.modern_name: formal neighbourhood of a section / twisted forms via torsor contracted product (projective structures, affine-to-projective twisting)
ideas.usually_credited_to: classical (Atiyah 1957 for extensions; Gunning, Deligne for projective structures)
ideas.where_published: contracted products of torsors are standard in SGA/Giraud; this specific computation is not known in print

ideas.what: Action on O(1)|formal neighbourhood is (1+a) times the ring action, i.e. weight shift g -> g/(1+a)^{n-1}.
ideas.modern_name: linearisation of O(1) under the unipotent radical of the parabolic

ideas.what: The extensions J^n/J^{n+2} of Sym^n Omega by Sym^{n+1} Omega have class -n·v_n(c), with c the class of E (continued on next page).
ideas.modern_name: extension classes of graded pieces of the adic filtration; Atiyah class of O(n) being n times that of O(1)
ideas.usually_credited_to: classical (Atiyah; standard in the theory of projective connections/opers)

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but routine calculation of the action of translations in the parabolic (homographies) on the completed symmetric algebra and on O(1), preparing the twisted description of formal neighbourhoods. Correct and standard; nothing absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: 'Vérifions ces[?] en général pas ce qui est nécessaire[?]' should read 'Vérifions ceci en général par acquit de conscience.'
'et faisant omega f=0[?]' is likely 'et faisant omega=0'.

In the first displayed formula, the last factor in the image appears as u_a(e) (x) u_{a*}(g), consistent with the transcription; the marginal note reads roughly 'e la section ... qui relève 1 de O_S (⊂ E)'.
Section 2 heading: 'On revient au cas général d'une extension quelc. de O_S par Omega, définie par un torseur T sous Omega, on trouve donc'.
